title: Armadillo – A DNS Server in Gleam for Homelab Use
summary: Armadillo is a DNS server implementation written in Gleam, designed specifically for homelab environments to provide local DNS resolution. The project leverages Gleam's type safety and concurrency features to build a lightweight, reliable DNS service for home network setups. This appears to be a hobbyist or personal project aimed at developers who want self-hosted DNS infrastructure.
problem_solved: Provides a self-hosted DNS resolution service for homelab networks, eliminating the need for external DNS providers for local domain names.
why_valuable: Enables homelab enthusiasts to run their own DNS infrastructure with the safety guarantees of Gleam's type system, offering privacy and customization for local network environments.
